Client.title: Client
Client.description: A registered client workspace owned by the authenticated user, optionally configured with Client Portal credentials.

name.description: Display name of the client (1 to 80 characters).

company.description: Optional company or organization label (0 to 80 characters).

notes.description: Optional brief context or engagement notes (0 to 300 characters).

colorHex.description: Hex accent color used to identify the client in app, portal, and widgets (e.g. #2555E6).

sortOrder.description: Display ordering index for client tabs and widget cycling.

portalEnabled.description: Whether email/password Client Portal login is enabled for this client.

portalEmail.description: Normalized lowercase portal login email (0 to 120 characters).

portalKey.description: 64-character lowercase hex PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 derived portal access key, or empty string when disabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on create and update.

ClientProject.title: ClientProject
ClientProject.description: A project belonging to a specific client workspace. Every client starts with a default project named after the client.

clientId.description: Document ID of the parent client under /users/{userId}/clients.

name.description: Display name of the project (1 to 80 characters).

description.description: Optional brief description or milestone summary (0 to 300 characters).

colorHex.description: Hex accent color for the project (e.g. #2555E6).

sortOrder.description: Display ordering index for project tabs and swipe paging.

defaultProject.description: Whether this is the client's default project.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on create and update.

ClientTask.title: ClientTask
ClientTask.description: An individual work task belonging to a specific client and project.

clientId.description: Document ID of the parent client under /users/{userId}/clients.

projectId.description: Document ID of the parent project under /users/{userId}/projects.

title.description: Short actionable task title (1 to 140 characters).

details.description: Optional task notes or deliverables (0 to 400 characters).

completed.description: Whether the task is marked as done.

dueLabel.description: Optional short target date or milestone label (0 to 40 characters).

createdByClient.description: Whether this task was submitted by the client via the Client Portal.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on create and update.

ClientPortal.title: ClientPortal
ClientPortal.description: Cryptographically keyed Client Portal root document (256-bit PBKDF2 derived ID). Never listable.

clientId.description: Document ID of the linked client.

clientName.description: Display name of the client (1 to 80 characters).

clientColorHex.description: Hex accent color for the client portal theme.

portalEmail.description: Normalized lowercase portal login email (3 to 120 characters).

active.description: Whether this client portal access key is currently active.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on create and update.

PortalProject.title: PortalProject
PortalProject.description: Read-only mirror of a client project exposed under /clientPortals/{portalKey}/projects.

portalKey.description: 64-character hex portal key matching parent document ID.

clientId.description: Document ID of the parent client.

name.description: Display name of the project (1 to 80 characters).

defaultProject.description: Whether this is the client's default project.

PortalTask.title: PortalTask
PortalTask.description: Client-visible task mirror under /clientPortals/{portalKey}/tasks. Clients may read and create new open tasks only.

portalKey.description: 64-character hex portal key matching parent document ID.

clientId.description: Document ID of the parent client.

projectId.description: Document ID of the parent project.

completed.description: Whether the task is completed (always false on client-created tasks).

dueLabel.description: Optional due date label (0 to 40 characters).

createdByClient.description: Whether this task was submitted via the Client Portal.

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: User-owned tasks scoped to clientId and projectId.

/clientPortals/{portalKey}.description: Capability-keyed Client Portal access metadata (256-bit derived key).

/clientPortals/{portalKey}/projects/{pro.description: Read-only client project mirrors for an active portal.

/clientPortals/{portalKey}/tasks/{taskId.description: Client-visible task mirrors and create-only client task submissions.
